_comment: Pinned third-party inputs of the staged runtime (roadmap Phase 5). Archives are verified by SHA-256 before use.

ibapi._provenance: Interactive Brokers' official Python client (TWS API 1050.02, author Interactive Brokers LLC, GPL-3.0-or-later). Staged from build/cache/ibapi/ibapi-10.50.2, whose files must match files_sha256.
